分工：SEC 作成解釋，CFTC 就該解釋提供指引，且釋令中的「we」與「our」只指 SEC。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The references in this release to "we" and "our" are to the Commission. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("CFTC") provides herein guidance relating to that interpretation.

verified_facts.fact: CFTC 的指引內容：CFTC 與其人員將以與該解釋一致的方式施行《商品交易法》，且某些非證券加密資產可能符合《商品交易法》裡「commodity」的定義。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Further, the CFTC provides herein guidance that the CFTC and its staff will administer the Commodity Exchange Act

verified_facts.fact: 註 48 把 commodity 那句收窄：除了 GENIUS Act 第 2 條所定義「由許可支付穩定幣發行人發行的支付穩定幣」以外的非證券加密資產，才可能符合《商品交易法》的 commodity 定義（7 U.S.C. 1a(9)）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: However, any non-security crypto asset, other than a "payment stablecoin issued by a permitted payment stablecoin issuer," as such terms are defined in section 2 of the GENIUS Act, could meet the definition of "commodity" under the Commodity Exchange Act.

verified_facts.fact: 釋令不改變兩個機關各自的法定職權。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Nothing in this release should be construed as altering the respective statutory authorities of the SEC or CFTC.

verified_facts.fact: 釋令自己寫明不創設任何新的法律義務。（引文在此截斷：接下去的 crypto asset-related securities 在 .txt 端點上被換行拆成 "crypto asset- related"，續抄就不是逐字。）
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The interpretation does not itself create any new legal obligations for issuers of, and investors in, digital securities

verified_facts.fact: 釋令沒有取代 Howey 判準，該判準是有拘束力的法院先例。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The interpretation in this release does not supersede or replace the Howey test, which is binding legal precedent.

verified_facts.fact: 國會審查法下的程序狀態：OMB 已把本解釋認定為 5 U.S.C. 804(2) 的 major rule；儘管有此認定，該解釋依 5 U.S.C. 808(2) 可立即生效，因為它是解釋性規則、免除行政程序法的通知評論要求。釋令本身沒有解釋 DATES 欄為何寫 3 月 23 日（must_fix 5）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the Office of Management and Budget (''OMB'') has designated the interpretation in this release as a ''major rule,'' as defined by 5 U.S.C. 804(2). Notwithstanding such designation, the interpretation in this release may take effect immediately pursuant to 5 U.S.C. 808(2) because it is an interpretive rule and thus exempt from the Administrative Procedure Act's notice and comment requirements.

verified_facts.fact: 釋令把加密資產分成五類。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: we classify crypto assets into five categories based on their characteristics, uses, and functions: (i) digital commodities; (ii) digital collectibles; (iii) digital tools; (iv) stablecoins; and (v) digital securities.

verified_facts.fact: 各類的法律定位：數位商品、數位收藏品與數位工具本身不是證券；穩定幣視特徵而定；數位證券是證券。非證券加密資產仍可能在附帶投資契約的情形下被要約與銷售，而投資契約本身是證券。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Digital commodities, digital collectibles, and digital tools, each as further described below, are not themselves securities. However, as with any asset that is not a security, a non-security crypto asset can be offered and sold subject to an investment contract, which is a security.

verified_facts.fact: 分類不是窮盡的：可能有不屬於這五類任一類的加密資產，也可能有具混合特徵、同時落在一類以上的。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: there may be crypto assets that do not fall within any of these five categories, as well as crypto assets with hybrid characteristics that may fall within more than one category.

verified_facts.fact: 具名例子只出現在五類中的三類：數位商品（Examples of digital commodities include …，註 51 帶「Based on our understanding of their characteristics, terms, and functions as of the date of this release」）、數位收藏品與數位工具（這兩類把同一段限定語寫在句子裡）。穩定幣與數位證券兩節沒有列任何具名資產（以 include／such as／example 三個字在該兩節內查核，2026-09-17 未見）。三份清單都以 include 起頭，是舉例不是全清單。文章因此不轉錄任何具名資產。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Examples of digital tools available in the markets today, based on our understanding of their characteristics, terms, and functions as of the date of this release, include

verified_facts.fact: 五類的法律定位在同一段裡逐句寫明，穩定幣那一句是「很寬的類別、可能是也可能不是證券，視其特徵而定」，數位證券那一句是「是證券」。兩句都帶「as further described below」。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Stablecoins, as further described below, are a broad category of crypto assets that may or may not be securities depending on their characteristics. Digital securities, as further described below, are securities.

verified_facts.fact: 迷因幣是釋令自己舉的例子，寫在數位收藏品那一節的「Some digital collectibles have limited or no functionality」之後。它舉的轉類例子附三個條件，一個都不能省：該加密資產起初以迷因幣形式要約與銷售、在相關的功能性加密系統裡「沒有」功能（不是「功能有限」）、且沒有要創設該功能或該系統的相關陳述或承諾，價值來自其藝術、娛樂、社會或文化意義；這樣的資產日後若在相關的功能性加密系統裡變得有功能，「可能」成為數位商品。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: a crypto asset may be offered and sold initially as a meme coin that has no functionality within an associated functional crypto system (and no related representations or promises to create such functionality or crypto system) and that derives its value from the asset's artistic, entertainment, social, or cultural significance, but later become a digital commodity because it becomes functional within an associated functional crypto system.

verified_facts.fact: GENIUS Act 第 17 條把「由許可支付穩定幣發行人發行的支付穩定幣」排除在「證券」的定義之外。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The GENIUS Act excludes from the definition of ''security'' any ''payment stablecoin issued by a permitted payment stablecoin issuer,'' as such terms are defined in section 2 of the GENIUS Act.

verified_facts.fact: 穩定幣的結論有時間條件：那個「當然不是證券」的效果要在 GENIUS Act 生效之後才依法發生（修正清單 must_add 6）。同段並寫明，非「由許可支付穩定幣發行人發行的支付穩定幣」的穩定幣，是不是證券要看事實與情形。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: These crypto assets categorically will not be securities by operation of statute after the effective date of the GENIUS Act.

verified_facts.fact: GENIUS Act 的生效日只寫公式，沒有日曆日期：制定日（2025 年 7 月 18 日）起 18 個月，或主要聯邦支付穩定幣主管機關發布任何最終施行規則後 120 天，取其早。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The GENIUS Act will become effective on the earlier of 18 months after its date of enactment (July 18, 2025) or the date that is 120 days after the date on which the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators issue any final regulations implementing the GENIUS Act.

verified_facts.fact: 因為 GENIUS Act 尚未生效，委員會解釋：依幕僚 2025 年 4 月 4 日 Staff Statement on Stablecoins 所述理由，Covered Stablecoins 的要約與銷售不涉及證券的要約與銷售；該解釋不處理 Covered Stablecoins 以外的穩定幣。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the Commission interprets that, for the reasons set forth in the Staff Stablecoin Statement, the offer and sale of Covered Stablecoins does not involve the offer and sale of securities

verified_facts.fact: 註 81（修正清單 must_add 2，對台灣讀者最直接相關）：雖然不在 GENIUS Act 第 17 條的法定排除裡，由在通貨監理局登記的「foreign permitted stablecoin issuer」所發行的支付穩定幣，一般不會符合「證券」的定義，因為一般會被認為是 Covered Stablecoins（GENIUS Act 第 18 條）。「generally」的限定詞原樣保留。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: payment stablecoins issued by a ''foreign permitted stablecoin issuer'' (as the term is defined in the GENIUS Act) registered with the Comptroller of the Currency will generally not meet the definition of ''security,'' as such payment stablecoins will generally be considered ''Covered Stablecoins.''

verified_facts.fact: GENIUS Act 第 4(a)(11) 條禁止許可支付穩定幣發行人單純因持有、使用或保留該支付穩定幣而對持有人支付任何形式的利息或收益（現金、代幣或其他對價皆然）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: A permitted payment stablecoin issuer is prohibited under the GENIUS Act from paying any form of interest or yield to the permitted stablecoin holders (whether in cash, tokens, or other consideration) solely in connection with the holding, use, or retention of the payment stablecoin.

verified_facts.fact: 非證券加密資產何時附帶投資契約：發行人以誘使他人在共同事業中投入金錢、並以陳述或承諾表示將從事必要管理努力、使購買人合理期待因此獲利的方式要約該資產時。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: A non-security crypto asset becomes subject to an investment contract when an issuer offers it by inducing an investment of money in a common enterprise with representations or promises to undertake essential managerial efforts from which a purchaser would reasonably expect to derive profits.

verified_facts.fact: 誰的陳述算數：由發行人所為或代其所為、並傳達給購買人的明示陳述或承諾，可使購買人合理期待獲利；第三人（例如與該加密系統無關的支持者或該加密資產的持有人）所為的則不合理，除非那些陳述或承諾經發行人授權並傳達給購買人。「unless」這個限定詞原樣保留。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: it would not be reasonable for a purchaser to expect profits based on representations or promises made by third parties,89 such as unaffiliated proponents of the relevant crypto system or holders of the relevant crypto asset, unless the representations or promises are authorized by the issuer and conveyed to purchasers.

verified_facts.fact: 註 89（修正清單 must_add 4）：第三人陳述不算數的原則有例外——第三人與發行人串通傳達陳述或承諾時，購買人依那些明示陳述或承諾期待獲利就是合理的。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: However, where the third party and the issuer collude to convey representations or promises, it would be reasonable for a purchaser to expect profits based on those explicit representations or promises.

verified_facts.fact: 發行人在銷售之後才作的陳述或承諾，不會把先前那次銷售變成投資契約的要約或銷售。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the issuer's post-sale representations or promises would not convert the prior sale into an offer or sale of an investment contract.

verified_facts.fact: 「分離」徵象是非窮盡的（non-exclusive），釋令自己編號的兩節分別是「1. Fulfillment of the Issuer's Representations or Promises」（發行人已完成所承諾的必要管理努力，即使仍繼續提供非必要的努力）與「2. Failure To Satisfy Issuer's Representations or Promises」（購買人已不再合理期待發行人能履行或繼續那些努力）；這裡的「兩」是釋令自己的小節編號，不是清點出來的。（掛在已刊登 PDF：.txt 端點把 non-exclusive 換行拆成 "non- exclusive"，逐字引文只在 PDF 上連續。）
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: As discussed below, we would not expect a non-security crypto asset to be subject to an investment contract when any of the following non-exclusive indicia of separation is present.

editorial_brief: 讀者是台灣一般讀者，不是法遵人員：看到「美國宣布多數加密資產不是證券」的標題，想知道那句話到底決定了什麼。全篇回答五件事——這是什麼文件、現在什麼狀態、管到誰、跟台灣讀者什麼關係、怎麼自己去官方頁查。三個軸：（1）這是 SEC 與 CFTC 聯名，不是 SEC 的公告，分工是 SEC 作成解釋、CFTC 就該解釋提供指引；（2）三個日期分開寫——2026-03-17 作成、2026-03-20 送存、2026-03-23 刊登兼生效，並照來源原話寫 OMB 的 major rule 認定與 5 U.S.C. 808(2)，同時明寫文件沒有解釋 DATES 欄為何是 3 月 23 日（不寫因果推論）；（3）「不是證券」是管轄與登記的答案，不是安全的答案——同一份文件保留反詐欺條款、保留過去未登記發行的責任、說類別會變，並明文不碰稅法、洗錢防制與任何非美國的法律。五節：文件是什麼／三個日期（表格）／五個類別與「本身不是證券」的射程（圖解）／投資契約的開始與結束，以及挖礦、質押、包裝、空投／它自己寫明沒有處理的事。原創情境（已標明是編輯設計的例子）：有人在境外平台用了質押功能，看到「質押不是證券交易」的標題，問這是不是代表平台受到監理——答案是釋令處理的是一組指名安排、沒有說任何業者有沒有登記、也明文把保證或固定獎勵的安排排除在範圍外。刻意不談：行情與市場反應；哪些資產可以持有；業者比較；GENIUS Act 的施行機制（那是 C6 至 C9 的題材，本篇只寫到釋令自己寫的部分）；2026-08-21 的「Regulation Crypto Assets」提案（來源範圍之外，見 unverified_or_excluded）。
must_not_write: 不要寫成 SEC 單方面發布。AGENCY 欄是兩個機關，署名欄是「By the Commissions」。分工要寫出來：SEC 作成解釋，CFTC 就該解釋提供指引。

diagram.title: 五類加密資產與投資契約
diagram.caption: 解釋令把加密資產分成五類；數位商品、數位收藏品與數位工具本身不是證券，穩定幣視特徵而定，數位證券是證券；非證券加密資產仍可能附帶投資契約，也可能與它分離。

diagram.caption: The release sorts crypto assets into five categories: digital commodities, digital collectibles and digital tools are not themselves securities, stablecoins depend on their characteristics, digital securities are securities; a non-security asset may carry an investment contract or separate from it.
